name: sweep a line while maintaining a front of parabolic arcs, handling site and circle events
mechanism: as a line sweeps across the sites, maintain the curve of points equidistant from the line and the nearest site behind it (a chain of parabolic arcs); a new site splits an arc, and three consecutive arcs whose sites are co-circular predict a vertex where the middle arc vanishes; processing these two event types in order builds all cell boundaries

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Fortune's Algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Geometry: create voronoi diagram

requires: an ordered structure for the arc front
fails_when: numerical fragility in the circle events
